items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: The interviewee (Lionel Ferbos) narrates a story about Elec and Peterson, but does not state he personally knew, met, or worked with Peterson.

ctx.x: Well from what I can remember, I hope I have it right, the early big guard came and asked me if I wanted to work with him. So, well I had been playing with big bands before then.

Well let me tell you the story. You know more about it than me. Elec went to Peterson's music store to see about some drumsticks or something. And Peterson said, Elec, you all playing anywhere? No. They want a band down at the Melody Inn for Mr. Highdown. So, Elec said, you know, you can go and see about the job. So, Elec called me and asked me about the job. And he said, you know, you can go and see about it. So, I told him, go and see about it. So, he got lying there, I got joys getting off, and myself to go…
So, in other words, it was a big odd job.
